usage: nanlm-unified-context <checkpoint-dir> <heads.csv> <credits.f32> <tokens.f32> <out.json> [--bank bank.tsv] [--top-k N] [--summary-k N] [--local-limit N] [--retrieve-head H] [--retrieve-k N] [--query query.f32]
bank: TSV: chunk_id token_count head f0..f127; contiguous identical chunk_id lines form one summary
flow: page checkpoint -> unified context runtime -> native worker -> summary retrieval
scope: transport/orchestration only; all attention and scoring are guest-side
